checks.description: Scripture slide creation via ESV fetch: reference input, fetch button, ESV text fetch, auto-split into slide-sized chunks, auto-save status indicator
checks.notes: Dev server responds 200. ScriptureSlideEditor has reference-input, fetch-btn, fetch-error, slides-container testids. Uses fetchPassageText from esvApi and splitPassage from scriptureSplitter. Auto-save via useAutoSave shows Saving.../Saved status. 15 component + 10 splitter + 15 store tests pass.

checks.description: Manual slide override: click slide text to edit, slide marked as overridden (visually distinct), auto-save triggers on edit
checks.notes: Manual editing works via textarea @input → onSlideInput. overriddenSlides ref (Set<number>) tracks edited indices and adds idx on edit. However, template slide card uses static class 'rounded-lg bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-700/50 p-4' — no conditional class binding on overriddenSlides.has(idx). Visual distinction requirement unmet. Auto-save triggers correctly.

checks.description: Congregational reading mode toggle: switches to CongregationalEditor, Leader/Congregation labels, speaker toggle, distinct styling per role
checks.notes: reading-mode-toggle with Normal/Congregational buttons. CongregationalEditor renders speaker-toggle buttons, Leader/Congregation labels with alternating default (idx%2===0?LEADER:CONGREGATION). Leader uses indigo, Congregation uses amber styling. Preview panel shows distinct labels per speaker. 15 CongregationalEditor tests pass.

checks.description: Reading mode persistence: toggle mode, collapse/re-expand editor, mode and assignments preserved
checks.notes: readingMode typed on ScriptureSlot. setReadingMode updates localService.value.slots[index]. Deep watcher on localService triggers auto-save (800ms debounce) via onSave→serviceStore.updateService. getSlotReadingMode reads persisted readingMode. On re-expand, the slot's persisted readingMode drives which editor renders. 16 integration tests pass.

checks.description: Empty reference guard: Edit Scripture Slides button not visible when no reference entered
checks.notes: v-if guard requires slotToScriptureRef(slot) which returns null when !slot.book||!slot.chapter||!slot.verseStart||!slot.verseEnd. Entire editor section hidden when reference incomplete.

checks.description: Viewer role restriction: Edit Scripture Slides button not visible for non-editor users
checks.notes: v-if guard includes authStore.isEditor (computed: userRole.value === 'editor'). Non-editor users cannot see the edit button or editing controls.

checks.description: Very long passage (e.g. Psalm 119) splits into many slides without error
checks.notes: splitPassage uses DEFAULT_WORDS_PER_SLIDE=50 with sentence-boundary splitting. No upper limit. 10 splitter unit tests pass.

checks.description: Invalid scripture reference shows error state, not crash
checks.notes: fetchError ref set true in catch block. Template shows error via v-if='fetchError' (data-testid='fetch-error'). canFetch prevents fetch when parseScriptureInput returns null.

checks.description: Rapid toggle between Normal/Congregational should not cause duplicate saves or state corruption
checks.notes: setReadingMode is synchronous. Auto-save watcher debounces 800ms with clearTimeout on each change. Only last change within window triggers save. No race condition.
